description: This file contains the implementation of a custom HTML lexer class 'HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DirectLex' for parsing HTML into tokens, used within an HTML purification library. It includes methods for tokenizing HTML, handling attributes, and processing inside the lexer.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DirectLex
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a custom, dependency-free HTML lexer for tokenizing HTML content into structured tokens, with support for line tracking and attribute parsing.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Main method to tokenize the input HTML string into an array of token objects, handling script normalization, comments, tags, and text nodes.

methods.name: parseAttributeString
methods.description: Parses a string of HTML tag attributes into an associative array of attribute key-value pairs.

methods.name: substrCount
methods.description: PHP 5.0-compatible implementation of substr_count with support for offset and length.
